pr.title: Fix NPE when accessing group concurrently

raw_findings.body: An exception (e.g. the NPE this PR fixes) can be recorded by the reader thread after the assertion has already run, so a regression would not fail the test; the spawned thread is also leaked because it is never joined or interrupted.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Flaky/false-negative test that can pass while the concurrent NPE still occurs.
raw_findings.impact: An exception (e.g. the NPE this PR fixes) can be recorded by the reader thread after the assertion has already run, so a regression would not fail the test; the spawned thread is also leaked because it is never joined or interrupted.
raw_findings.root_cause: The newly added concurrency test asserts on a shared CopyOnWriteArrayList without synchronizing on the reader thread's completion.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Capture the Thread reference, call thread.join() (with a timeout) after deletedAll.set(true) and before assertThat, so all reader activity has completed and every caught exception is observed.
raw_findings.title: Reader thread not joined before asserting caught exceptions
raw_findings.trigger: The reader thread is mid-request (or about to add to caughtExceptions) at the instant the main thread executes deletedAll.set(true) followed immediately by assertThat.

raw_findings.body: The method returns null, contradicting the GroupModel.getSubGroupsCount() javadoc which states 'Never returns null.'; any caller that unboxes the Long or relies on the documented non-null guarantee will NPE.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Silent contract violation that can surface as an NPE in unboxing callers.
raw_findings.impact: The method returns null, contradicting the GroupModel.getSubGroupsCount() javadoc which states 'Never returns null.'; any caller that unboxes the Long or relies on the documented non-null guarantee will NPE.
raw_findings.root_cause: The concurrency fix introduces a null return path that is not permitted by the overridden interface's documented contract.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Either return a non-null value (e.g. 0L) when the model is gone, or update the GroupModel.getSubGroupsCount() javadoc to explicitly allow null and audit unboxing callers.
raw_findings.title: getSubGroupsCount may now return null, violating GroupModel contract
raw_findings.trigger: The cached group is concurrently deleted so modelSupplier.get() resolves to null and getSubGroupsCount() is invoked.

finding.title: Reader thread not joined before asserting caught exceptions
finding.trigger: The reader thread is mid-request (or about to add to caughtExceptions) at the instant the main thread executes deletedAll.set(true) followed immediately by assertThat.
finding.verifier_reason: The patch at line 157 shows `assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty())` is called immediately after `deletedAll.set(true)` without joining the reader thread. The thread spawned at line 149 via `.start()` is never joined, so exceptions added to `caughtExceptions` after the assertion runs would be missed, making the test flaky/false-negative. The thread reference is also not captured, causing a resource leak.

finding.root_cause: The concurrency fix introduces a null return path that is not permitted by the overridden interface's documented contract.

finding.title: getSubGroupsCount may now return null, violating GroupModel contract
finding.trigger: The cached group is concurrently deleted so modelSupplier.get() resolves to null and getSubGroupsCount() is invoked.
finding.verifier_reason: Line 275 in the patch shows `return model == null ? null : model.getSubGroupsCount();` which introduces a null return path. The GroupModel.java interface at lines 293-300 documents `@return The number of groups beneath this group. Never returns {@code null}.` The patch violates this contract. GroupUtils.java line 90 calls `group.getSubGroupsCount()` and passes result to `setSubGroupCount(Long)` which could cause NPE if callers unbox the Long.
